Strategy Signs

Accepted queuing spends one use; canceling does not refund it. Activation spends none. Signs normally wait for the starting signal, next start/finish crossing, or Rally Sign Point. If the Worker has just passed the still-visible boundary, an accepted delay-window request takes effect at its next natural AI decision; no rewind or extra use. P1.3 Push orders maximum-effort Sprint; Conserve orders Conserve. Native constraints take priority; exceptional headstrong drivers can resist.
